import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        long mod = sc.nextLong();
        final int MAXN = 505;
        long[][] C = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            C[i][0] = C[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j] + C[i-1][j-1]) % mod;
            }
        }
        long[] dp1 = new long[MAXN];
        long[] dp2 = new long[MAXN];
        dp1[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                dp1[i] = (dp1[i] + dp1[j-1] * dp1[i-j] % mod * C[i-1][j-1]) % mod;
            }
            dp1[i] = (i+1) * dp1[i] % mod;
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                dp2[i] = (dp2[i] + (i+1) * C[i-1][j-1] % mod * ((dp1[j-1]*dp2[i-j] + dp2[j-1]*dp1[i-j]) % mod)) % mod;
                dp2[i] = (dp2[i] + C[i-1][j-1] * dp1[j-1] % mod * dp1[i-j] % mod * ((j*(j-1)/2 + (i-j)*(i-j+1)/2) % mod)) % mod;
            }
        }
        long[][] dp3 = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
        long[][] dp4 = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
        dp3[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                dp3[i][j] = dp3[i-1][j];
                dp4[i][j] = dp4[i-1][j];
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    dp3[i][j] = (dp3[i][j] + dp3[i-k-1][j-k] * dp1[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod;
                    dp4[i][j] = (dp4[i][j] + dp3[i-k-1][j-k] * dp2[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod;
                    dp4[i][j] = (dp4[i][j] + dp4[i-k-1][j-k] * dp1[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod;
                }
            }
            dp3[i][i] = dp1[i];
            dp4[i][i] = dp2[i];
        }
        System.out.println(dp4[(int)n][(int)m]);
    }
}
